name: labs/trash-hold__oscilloscope_dimserver
title: Tektronix TDS3054C oscilloscope (oscilloscope_dimserver)
intro: Tektronix TDS3054C oscilloscope (oscilloscope_dimserver), adapted from trash-hold/oscilloscope_dimserver. It reads `horizontal_increment`; sets `channel`, `channel_enabled`, `vertical_scale`, `vertical_position` and 5 more; runs `single_acquisition` and `stop_acquisition`. `single_acquisition`: run one single-sequence acquisition and wait for it to finish (the native sample). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
